title: Mainoo on derby day v Rooney, Ronaldo and Foden at the same age
checked: Derby 13 Sep 2026 at Old Trafford: City won 1-0, Haaland (11v11, Corriere dello Sport, other score sites). Mainoo (b. 19 Apr 2005) youngest starter (Oddschecker + K24 line-ups) = 21y 147d. Same age: Ronaldo (b. 5 Feb 1985) 2 Jul 2006, summer: 18 PL goals in 95 PL games (29/4, 33/5, 33/9); Rooney (b. 24 Oct 1985) 20 Mar 2007: 42 PL goals before 2006-07 began (Everton 6+9, United 11+16), a lower bound, so 'more than forty'; Foden (b. 28 May 2000) 22 Oct 2021: 15 PL goals to 2020-21 plus 1 v Liverpool 3 Oct 2021 = 16, PL titles 2018, 2019, 2021 (Wikipedia tables, Premier League site). Mainoo: 4 PL goals in 83 PL games to 20 Sep 2026 (Wikipedia). FA Cup final 25 May 2024: City 1-2 United, Garnacho 30', Mainoo 39' from Fernandes' no-look pass, first time past Ortega; Doku late (manutd.com, Soccerway). Mainoo started the Euro 2024 final (Wikipedia, UEFA). A Mainoo shot off the post in the derby is in one live feed only, so left out.

lines.text: Derby day in September. The youngest man to start was Kobbie Mainoo, twenty-one years and 147 days old.
lines.say: Derby day in September. The youngest man to start was Kobbee Maynoo, twenty-one years and a hundred and forty-seven days old.

lines.text: City won one-nil at Old Trafford. Erling Haaland, of course.
lines.say: City won one-nil at Old Trafford. Erling Hohland, of course.

lines.text: So what had the great derby players done by Mainoo's age, to the day?
lines.say: So what had the great derby players done by Maynoo's age, to the day?

lines.text: Cristiano Ronaldo hit that age in the summer of 2006. Eighteen Premier League goals in ninety-five games.
lines.say: Cristeeahno Ronaldo hit that age in the summer of twenty oh-six. Eighteen Premier League goals in ninety-five games.

lines.text: Wayne Rooney, March 2007. Already more than forty Premier League goals, for Everton and United.
lines.say: Wayne Rooney, March twenty oh-seven. Already more than forty Premier League goals, for Everton and United.

lines.text: Phil Foden, October 2021. Sixteen goals, and three league titles already.
lines.say: Phil Foden, October twenty twenty-one. Sixteen goals, and three league titles already.

scene.title: Premier League goals
scene.note: Rooney: 42 before 2006/07 began, more by March

lines.text: Last place, by a mile. But Rooney, Ronaldo and Foden were attackers. Mainoo plays in midfield.
lines.say: Last place, by a mile. But Rooney, Ronaldo and Foden were attackers. Maynoo plays in midfield.

lines.text: And when it mattered most against City, he delivered. The 2024 FA Cup final. Bruno Fernandes, no-look pass. Mainoo.
lines.say: And when it mattered most against City, he delivered. The twenty twenty-four FA Cup final. Brunoh Fernandez, no-look pass. Maynoo.

lines.text: United won two-one. A nineteen-year-old's winner, at Wembley, against City.

scene.note: Garnacho and Mainoo score, Doku pulls one back

lines.text: Seven weeks later, he started a Euros final for England. Goals aren't the whole story.

items.label: FA Cup final winner v City

lines.text: So who was the best twenty-one-year-old in derby history? Mainoo, or Rooney?
lines.say: So who was the best twenty-one-year-old in derby history? Maynoo, or Rooney?

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
